item.title: Community spirit shines at annual ticket auction, raising funds for seniors
item.description: EATON — The spirit of generosity and community was on full display at our recent Annual Ticket Auction, an event that brought together friends, neighbors and local businesses to support seniors in the area. Thanks to the incredible support of donors, attendees, volunteers and staff, the auction raised $3,642 to benefit programs and services for local seniors. The post Community spirit shines at annual ticket auction, raising funds for seniors appeared first on The Register Herald.
